retraction.reason: Retracted in M22: the earthquake of 9 July 1998 off Faial, magnitude 6.1, with a long aftershock sequence on the Pedro Miguel graben faults. As with the earthquake of 1980, the atlas holds nothing it can be argued to have changed — no reconstruction, no building rules, no part for the regional government — and the cached lead is entirely about the tectonics.
